<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/update_download"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Start a download of the selected artifact.

Returns 202 Accepted when the download is started successfully in a
background thread.  Returns 409 Conflict when a download is already in
progress, reporting the in-flight version and progress percentage.

On a containerised install returns 409 Conflict with
``{"reason": "container_managed"}`` for every request, before any state
read, outbound artifact request, or staging write.
